capture.admission: No compiler or fixture operation before the owning admission commit, exact source and required current installed-epoch revalidation, separately active execution owner and exclusively consumed one-use permit.
capture.cleanup: Only after the sole runner exits and its direct compiler owners are proved settled: independent exact before/after census, same-volume/UID/identity/byte equality, exact per-node unlink/rmdir receipts and final absence. Unknown or changed nodes remain retained.
capture.compiler_membership: After successful native preparation and before controlled roles, record the canonical ASCII JSON SHA-256 of the complete metadata projection, node count and aggregate. Reconstruct that projection from the single final full-byte capture excluding exactly the controlled wrapper and Cargo link; do not duplicate a full metadata or byte census in the journal.
capture.failure: Every first compiler return and failed preparation is retained. An incomplete or unproved compiler outcome stops the run with no further case or cleanup; the first failed prototype walk preserves its error/prefix when available. Any blocked workspace needs separately owned read-only diagnosis, never an automatic replay.
capture.ownership: Record exclusive root creation before compilation; archive the first compiler return before role additions or prototype census. Stop on first unexpected outcome; never replay or silently normalize.
capture.perl: Use the current inactive PrivateWorkspace::_walk on each settled workspace; preserve its original result/error and node prefix. It grants no runtime authority.
capture.python: Independently census every current direct owned node under the declared roots using the pinned qualified file reader plus explicit no-follow link custody; compare full membership, identities, modes, sizes, hashes and link targets before any exact cleanup.
capture.shell_boundary: The fixed execute_once.sh uses the installed read-only /bin/bash and /usr/bin/env to invoke the pinned Perl in a closed environment. Consume its terminal tool result and runner.exit before independent review; the shell receipt is not native driver-image attestation.

cargo_role.scope: Controlled resolver-link role only; the production test derives an absolute target at runtime. This census uses an equivalent workspace-local relative target to keep persisted project paths relocatable. No wrapper or Cargo link is executed; this does not qualify actual native resolution.

claim_legs.durability: Preserve the earlier rejected invocation and unused permit, first policy probes and corrections, source qualification, canonical procedure handoff and this admission commit before a distinct one-use execution epoch.
claim_legs.falsification: Reject wider ignore policy, hidden shared paths, ambient Git overrides, changed source/permit/limits, incomplete workspace or process settlement, and promotion of source models to actual compiler profiles.
claim_legs.rederivation: Exact inherited compiler/prototype inputs, first rejection, current installed compiler/SDK/interpreter/Git pins, direct ordinary/closed/repository Git views and fixed request/census models.

compiler.selection: Unmodified prepare_rust_proxy current native selection and exact fixed compilation request/environment; no source seam, compiler override, argv or deadline changes.

journal_derivation.meaning: Includes both full workspace records, worst-case escaped regular bytes and symlink targets, paths and metadata; no duplicated full census record.

evidence_limits.meaning: The independently qualified reader can observe one extra file-boundary byte; this grants no retirement capacity. Any capture ceiling or membership failure is retained as incomplete evidence and prevents cleanup/qualification.

git_policy.scope: Required installed read-only Git launcher. Every admission Git command uses this exact binary, repository-local ignore input, root-derived temporary directory and closed environment; personal Git configuration is not required. Loaded Git image and dynamic dependencies are not exhaustively attested.

interpreter_access: Required installed read-only Perl and user-owned Homebrew Python runtimes. Explicit off-volume inputs with stable identity and byte pins; no off-volume outputs. Dynamic libraries and actual loaded images are not exhaustively attested. Compiler/SDK root-owned checks remain unchanged.
nonclaims: No native execution, canonical publication or product activation.
No historical startup cause or performance benefit.
No complete SDK/header/library or loaded-image attestation.
Real compiler subtree evidence is distinct from the controlled wrapper/Cargo roles and from failed/incomplete capture.

prior_rejection.rule: Retain the original rejected invocation and unused permit; never recreate or consume them. These fixed compiler roots remain fresh because the first runner stopped before creation. Use only this distinct newly committed output/permit epoch.

process_receipt.failure: Any missing original terminal state or unsettled result blocks cleanup and all later launches; preserve first returned failure and ownership evidence.
process_receipt.meaning: Record direct-child PID, raw wait status and final original supervisor state/result after settlement. Direct fork ownership is protected until reap; this is not a general authenticated compiler/outer/inner receipt adapter or loaded-compiler-image attestation.
process_receipt.seam: Observe the exact state reference returned by FSM::Support::ProcessSupervisor::_start_supervision without changing its arguments, result, control flow or doing I/O in that post-fork observer.

source_qualification: Syntax and data/mocked-I/O/request/settlement/permit controls only before the admission commit; no real compiler, proxy, wrapper, original, collector or fixture operation.

workspace_policy.meaning: Unchanged inactive retirement policy; only actual complete accepted profiles can qualify this selected domain.
